items.q: there was Bucky Pizzarelli, a great guitarist, and I enjoyed working with him.

ctx.x: Of not getting in the way, like Eddie Condon, and there was Bucky Pizzarelli, a great guitarist, and I enjoyed working with him. And the epitome -- well, not the epitome, but one of the greats was from Texas, Herb Ellis.
